license_required.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

issuing_authority.value: Louisiana Department of Insurance / Commissioner of Insurance
issuing_authority.quote: A person applying for a resident insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner of insurance

name.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

type.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least eighteen years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: Is not disqualified for having committed any act that is a ground for denial, suspension, or revocation as set forth in R.S. 22:1554.

required.quote: The Bail Bond Apprentice Program shall consist of three consecutive months of employment by a Department of Insurance licensed bail bond producer.

experience_source.quote: The Bail Bond Apprentice Program shall consist of three consecutive months of employment by a Department of Insurance licensed bail bond producer.

duration.quote: The Bail Bond Apprentice Program shall consist of three consecutive months of employment by a Department of Insurance licensed bail bond producer. The apprentice shall be supervised by the producer during the three-month period and work for no less than twenty-four hours per week.

kind.quote: The Bail Bond Apprentice Program is hereby created.

exams.name: Bail Bond Producer Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Applicant must pass with at least 70%. No person may sit for the exam until completion of the Bail Bond Apprentice Program.
exams.quote: No person shall be permitted to sit for an examination as a bail bond producer until completion of this apprenticeship program and until the required certification of the completion has been submitted to the Department of Insurance along with the required application for testing and licensure.

interval_years.quote: Every licensed producer shall file an application for renewal of his license every two years

required.quote: For bail bond producers, the continuing education requirement for renewal of license shall be twelve hours of approved bail underwriting instruction.

hours_per_period.quote: For bail bond producers, the continuing education requirement for renewal of license shall be twelve hours of approved bail underwriting instruction.

period_years.quote: Every licensed producer shall file an application for renewal of his license every two years

topical_requirements.quote: For bail bond producers, the continuing education requirement for renewal of license shall be twelve hours of approved bail underwriting instruction. At least six of the hours shall be dedicated to matters related to bail enforcement as defined in Code of Criminal Procedure Article 311.

available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to R.S. 22:1554, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident producer license if: (1) The person is currently licensed as a resident and in good standing in his home state.

requirements.value: Nonresident must be currently licensed and in good standing in home state, submit proper application and fees, and home state must award nonresident licenses to Louisiana residents on the same basis.
requirements.quote: The person's home state awards nonresident producer licenses to residents of this state on the same basis.

exists.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

credential_type.quote: "License" shall mean a document issued by this state's commissioner of insurance authorizing a person to act as an insurance producer for the lines of authority specified in the document.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

title_protection.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person or business entity, without conforming to the provisions of this Part, directly or indirectly, to represent himself or itself to be an insurance producer or limited lines producer, or to solicit, negotiate, or effect any contract of insurance or renewal thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any prerequisite of state or federal law or regulations for the issuance of such license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to comply with any prerequisite of state or federal law or regulations for the issuance of such license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing incorrect, misleading, incomplete, or materially false information in the license or renewal application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing incorrect, misleading, incomplete, or materially false information, or omission of material information, in the license or renewal application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to account for or remit premiums, monies, or properties belonging to another, or misappropriating funds received in the course of doing insurance business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to account for or remit any premiums, monies, or properties belonging to another which come into the possession of the applicant in the course of doing insurance business, or improperly withholding, misappropriating, converting, or failing to timely remit any premiums, monies, or properties received in the course of doing insurance business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices or misrepresentation, or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility in the conduct of business such as might endanger the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting the terms of an actual or proposed insurance contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresenting the terms of an actual or proposed insurance contract, binder, rider, plan, or application for insurance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having admitted or been found to have committed any insurance unfair trade practice or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having admitted or been found to have committed any insurance unfair trade practice under R.S. 22:1961 et seq. or fraud under R.S. 22:1964 et seq.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction or nolo contendere plea to any felony, or conviction of any misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or public corruption.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction or nolo contendere plea to any felony, participation in a pretrial diversion program pursuant to a felony charge, suspension and deferral of sentence and probation pursuant to Code of Criminal Procedure Article 893, or conviction of any misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or public corruption.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license through misrepresentation or fraud, or cheating on an examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license through misrepresentation or fraud, or improperly using notes or any other reference material to complete an examination for an insurance license, or otherwise cheating or attempting to cheat on an examination for an insurance license of any kind.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication of bankruptcy with debts related to receipt or transmittal of insurance premiums or other funds in a fiduciary capacity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The adjudication of bankruptcy with debts related to the receipt or transmittal of insurance premiums or other funds to an insurer or insured in any fiduciary capacity of the applicant, or issuance to the Department of Insurance of an insufficient fund or no-fund check.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Forging another's name to an application for insurance or any document related to an insurance transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Forging another's name to an application for insurance or to any document related to an insurance transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly accepting insurance business from a person who is not licensed as a producer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly accepting insurance business from a person who is not licensed as a producer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procurement of a license for the purpose of writing controlled business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The procurement of a license for the purpose of writing controlled business, as prohibited in this Subpart.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an insurance producer license denied, suspended, or revoked in this or any other state, province, district, or territory.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an insurance producer license, or its equivalent, denied, suspended, or revoked in this or any other state, province, district, or territory.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any insurance laws of the United States, this state or any state, or any lawful rule, regulation, subpoena, or order of the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any insurance laws of the United States, this state or any state, province, district, or territory, or violating any lawful rule, regulation, subpoena, or order of the commissioner of insurance or of the insurance officials of another state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay state income taxes or comply with any administrative or court order directing payment of state income taxes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to pay state income taxes or comply with any administrative or court order directing payment of state income taxes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or associating with any person engaged in the business of insurance who has been convicted of a felony, without consent or waiver from the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A producer, without the consent of or a waiver from the commissioner, has employed or has allowed to associate with his business, in any manner, any person engaged in the business of insurance who has been convicted of a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony involving dishonesty or breach of trust pursuant to 18 U.S.C. 1033 and 1034 without written consent from the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of a felony involving dishonesty or breach of trust pursuant to 18 U.S.C. 1033 and 1034, without written consent from the commissioner of insurance pursuant to 18 U.S.C. 1033

value: No bail bond business with any person other than the defendant, the indemnitor, an attorney, or in the case of a minor a parent or guardian, in or on the grounds of a courthouse or jail for the purpose of executing a bail bond
solicitation_restrictions.quote: Conduct bail bond business with any person other than the defendant, the indemnitor, and an attorney or in the case of a minor, a parent or guardian, in or on the grounds of a courthouse or jail for the purpose of executing a bail bond.

rebate_and_kickback_prohibition.quote: Pay a fee or rebate or give or promise anything of value to a jailer, police officer, peace officer, or committing magistrate or any other person who has power to arrest or hold in custody or to any public official or public employee in order to secure a client, bailee, settlement, compromise, remission, or reduction of the amount of any bail bond.

firearm_permit_required_for_enforcement.quote: Any bail enforcement agent who carries a concealed firearm is subject to the concealed handgun permit requirements of this state as provided in R.S. 40:1379.3.

law_enforcement_notification_before_appr.quote: The regulations adopted by the commissioner shall include provisions governing: ... (3) The notification of local law enforcement agencies.

surrender_of_principal_rules.quote: Before a breach of an undertaking occurs, a surety or bail bond producer may surrender a defendant, or the defendant may surrender himself, to the official to whose custody the defendant was committed at the time the bail was given.

residency_requirement.quote: Resides in the state or maintains his principal place of business in the state.

prelicense_education_hours.quote: Apprentices shall complete eight hours of instruction in applicable underwriting principles, state laws, and regulations, and ethical practices before the end of the apprenticeship program.

continuing_education_exemption_for_senio.quote: The provisions of this Section, imposing continuing education requirements for renewal of a license, shall not apply to any person sixty-five years of age or older who has at least fifteen years of experience as a licensed producer

bail_bond_agency_license_separate_from_a.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer shall obtain an insurance producer license.
